priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Stop logging issued tokens in plaintext
findings.body: Every call writes the full issued token to stdout. In environments that collect application logs, anyone with log access could recover and replay these credentials.

findings.title: [P1] Restrict login return URLs before navigating
findings.body: The fixed same-origin dashboard redirect is replaced with an arbitrary string passed directly to location.assign. A return URL originating from login parameters can therefore send users to an attacker-controlled origin or use a dangerous URL scheme; enforce an allowed same-origin path or explicit allowlist.

findings.title: [P2] Apply the anonymous fallback after trimming
findings.body: Trimming an all-whitespace cached value produces an empty string, and nullish coalescing does not treat that as missing. The function consequently returns an empty display name instead of the established Anonymous fallback; the normalized value must be checked for emptiness.
